dataviz: Make a chart or graph from data: bar, line or pie charts, plots, dashboards, stat tiles, from CSV, spreadsheets or numbers.
update-config: Change Claude Code settings.json: hooks, permissions, env vars, automated 'whenever X do Y' behaviours.
keybindings-help: Customize Claude Code keyboard shortcuts in ~/.claude/keybindings.json.
code-review: Review the current diff, a PR number, or a branch for correctness bugs.
simplify: Clean up changed code for reuse, simplicity and efficiency, then apply the fixes.
fewer-permission-prompts: Add an allowlist of common read-only commands to cut Claude Code permission prompts.
loop: Run a prompt or slash command repeatedly on an interval, or poll for status.
schedule: Create or manage scheduled cloud agents that run on a cron schedule or once at a set time.
claude-api: Build with the Claude API or Anthropic SDK: model ids, pricing, tool use, caching, streaming.
run: Launch and drive this project's app to see a change working, or screenshot it.
init: Create a CLAUDE.md file documenting a codebase.
security-review: Security review of the pending changes on the current branch.
